cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

mechanism: A borrows apparent confidential-office rituals to recruit B into a surprise plan, covering corrections instead of admitting ignorance.
confusable: S04 mistaken ritual differs from competent secrecy; D07 requires B's active task.
comparison: Workplace scheduling leverage differs from family entertainment.
seedUse: D07-b converts a real work prerequisite into A's contribution to the secret.
